description: Alert / success pop-up over a screen: clean screen + a dimmed screenshot that shows the same kind of pop-up + the new message. Learns the pop-up letters from the donor's own message.

inputs.screen: the screen the pop-up should appear on (may have red boxes - they are cleared)
inputs.donor: a dimmed screenshot showing the pop-up to copy (same app, same pop-up style)
inputs.donor_message: the exact message text shown in the donor pop-up
